<Heading

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/auth/me"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Hard-deletes the authenticated account and cascades to everything it
owns — posts, comments, reactions, favorites, chat messages, push
tokens, personal access tokens and notifications. There is no restore
and no deactivated state, and every session and media token for the
account stops working immediately.

Refused with `400` if you are the only admin on the server: promote
someone else first, otherwise the deployment would be left with no
one able to administer it.

Session-authenticated requests only — a personal access token gets a
`403`, so a leaked token can't wipe the account it was scoped to.
